about: Gold set for M1 retrieval. The ten methods our decision tables cannot currently evidence (see docs/METHODOLOGY-RULES.md), plus two controls. Each names the document that must be retrieved; we already know the right answer, so retrieval either finds it or it does not.

thresholds.note: Correct document in the top 5 for >=9 of 10 gold queries. Controls must also pass.
